description: Drafts deal-specific sales collateral such as one-pagers, executive summaries, solution briefs, case study drafts, demo narratives, proposal inserts, and stakeholder messaging matrices, tailored to the buyer's industry, role, seniority, and stated priorities. Use when a rep needs a leave-behind for a champion, material for an executive sponsor or technical evaluator, customer proof for 'who else uses this?', a storyline for an upcoming demo, an RFP or proposal section, or messaging for a multi-stakeholder deal.
